The in-universe 1970s-style super robot anime (full title ゲキ・ガンガー3) loved by Gai Daigoji and Akito; also the name of its robot.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Zentradi exclamation of shock/awe at human culture.
Gigantic sentient alien ship buried under the Pacific; its awakening threatens Earth; base of the Reclaimers
Orphan's disc plates sought by the Reclaimers; ALSO (crossover) inscribed plates carrying a Zentradi/Protoculture song.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: SDF-1 Macross, the U.N. Spacy super-dimensional fortress (human flagship).

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Idol singer aboard the Macross; her songs (culture) are the key to defeating the Zentradi.
glossary.personality: Bright, cheerful and ambitious pop idol, somewhat self-absorbed; infatuated with Hikaru.

glossary.role: Daughter of the noble Gaw house and a rising member of Poseidal's Thirteen; defects to Daba's rebels. Later captains the Whale and pilots the Novel D-Sserd.
glossary.personality: Bold, headstrong and reckless yet emotionally fragile; competes with Amu for Daba; becomes calmer and more mature later in the series.

report.translator_summary: Translated all 80 rows of op26_01. Covers strategic and tactical briefings by Misa Hayase regarding the Meltrandi all-female fleet invading atmospheric space, Phase 1 battle escorting SDF-1 Macross and defending Orphan, pilot banter regarding Meltrandi mecha design, the impact of Lynn Minmay's singing causing Deculture among alien forces, Zentradi peace overtures, and the first part of Captain Global's debriefing on Culture.
